Vanda coerulea botanical treatment (scientific workflow pipeline test fixture, authored 2026-10-11; CC0-1.0; synthetic test fixture, not a published description)

Abstract

Plants monopodial epiphytes with an elongate leafy stem 30-60 cm tall; pseudobulbs absent. Leaves distichous, strap-shaped (lorate), leathery, 8-15 cm long, the apex obliquely bilobed. Inflorescence axillary, erect, 10-20-flowered. Flowers resupinate, 7-10 cm across, sky-blue with darker tessellated markings. Sepals and petals similar, obovate, shortly clawed. Labellum small, 3-lobed, spurred at the base; spur conical, 5-7 mm long. Pollinia 2, waxy, globose, borne on a short stipe with a single viscidium. Flowering September to November.
